title: Molecular compatibility in photocatalyst-dependent THF amidation
difficulty_reasons: Choose and execute molecular tests for an open explanatory question without a prescribed physical descriptor or computational route.
Relate a molecular model to qualitative productivity comparisons without confusing isolated yields with rate constants or ignoring irradiation/loading differences.
Separate supported conclusions from method dependence, limited observations and untested reaction stages.
